fsr4.hint411: FSR 4.1 in Metal: AMD's 4.1 network with fast math, full quality. Uses the player's 4.1.1 initializers (tools/fsr4_metal_initializers.sh).
fsr4.hint: FSR 4 in INT8 mode (model v07 from the AMD FidelityFX SDK sources). Higher quality than FSR 3.1, but a heavier pass. Changing the preset rebuilds the model (a short pause). Assets: tools/fetch_fsr4_assets.sh.
fsr4.checkHint: For checking ghosting: the FSR 4 network normalizes color by exposure and uses it to decide when to discard past frames. Applied immediately, no restart.
preset.taaNote: TAA anti-aliases the scene at the output resolution, without an FSR model or upscaling. The saved FSR preset comes back when FSR is selected.
preset.fixedHint: BB_RENDER_RES fixes the scene size at start. Remove that explicit variable to change the resolution and presets without restarting the game.
preset.hint: Native AA: FSR works as anti-aliasing. The other presets lower the scene's render resolution relative to the output. The interface is drawn at the output resolution. The preset applies from the next frame, without restarting the game.
sharpen.hint: Up to 1: the upscaler's own sharpening (RCAS). Above 1 another RCAS pass is added. Ctrl+click the slider to enter an exact value.
jitter.label: Sub-pixel jitter
jitter.hint: Every frame the scene is shifted by a fraction of a pixel, and the upscaler gathers more detail from several frames. Without it there is only anti-aliasing from the history.
reactive.hint: Marks transparent effects (particles, haze) so the upscaler relies less on past frames. Fewer trails behind effects, but shimmering returns under them.
motion.showHint: Red/green: horizontal/vertical motion (8 pixels = full brightness). Blue: the pixel got an exact object vector, not only the camera's motion. A moving object with neither blue nor red/green is treated as still by the upscaler, hence a trail.
output.fixedHint: Size of the finished frame and the interface. The preset sets the scene size relative to the output: 4K Performance = 1920x1080. Applies after restarting the game.
output.liveHint: The size of the finished frame and the interface changes at the next frame. The preset sets the scene size relative to the output: 4K Performance = 1920x1080. Changing the size resets the FSR history and may cause a short pause.
effects.debugHint: Free camera: hold Cross and press L3 (keyboard: Space + Z). Debug menu: left touchpad / Tab. Needs DbgFont14h.ccm and DbgFont14h.tpf in dvdroot_ps4/font from Nexus mod #253. Right touchpad: Backspace.
restart.note: Changes apply after restarting the game
effects.effect_ssr: SSR reflections (not in the original game)
dlss.hint: NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution (RTX GPUs; Native AA is DLAA). Needs the DLSS bridge and NVIDIA's library next to the game; otherwise FSR 3.1 is used.
menu.heading: Settings
menu.syncedLauncher: Changes are saved to the launcher's settings.
launcher.graphics.title: Graphics
launcher.graphics.aspectRatioHint: Wider screens show more to the sides and taller ones more above and below; the HUD stays at the edges.
launcher.graphics.upscalingHint: The game renders below the output resolution and FSR reconstructs the image: the biggest performance lever on Apple Silicon.
launcher.graphics.effectsHint: Turn off what you don't like, or to gain a little performance.
launcher.graphics.memoryHint: Game and graphics memory at the next start with these settings.
launcher.graphics.memoryHigh: More than three quarters of this computer's memory: the game may slow down or stop. Choose a lower output or preset.
launcher.graphics.monitorHint: Where the game window and fullscreen open.
launcher.graphics.metalHudHint: Apple's statistics overlay for Metal: frame time, GPU time and memory. Applies when the game starts.
launcher.graphics.objectMotionHint: Less ghosting on moving characters with FSR. Costs about 5 ms per frame on Apple GPUs.
launcher.game.title: Game
launcher.advanced.title: Advanced
launcher.advanced.rendererHint: What draws the game on macOS. Metal is the new native renderer, still experimental.
launcher.advanced.readbacks: GPU data read by the CPU
launcher.advanced.liveResolutionHint: Change the output and preset without restarting, at a performance cost.
launcher.advanced.debugCameraHint: Hold Cross and press L3 to cycle modes (keyboard: Space + Z).
launcher.advanced.debugMenuHint: Needs DbgFont14h.ccm and DbgFont14h.tpf in the game's dvdroot_ps4/font. Opens with the left touchpad or Tab.
launcher.options.fps.uncapHint: Each frame's real time: any frame rate, physics kept right
launcher.options.drawPipe.autoHint: On with 8 or more CPU threads
launcher.options.upscaler.fsr3Hint: Renders below the output and reconstructs it
fsr4.hint411lossy: FSR 4.1 Lossy in Metal: the 4.1 network with the six trained layers from the community weights (fetched at build time, GPL). Faster than 4.1 with some detail loss. Uses the player's 4.1.1 initializers.
fsr4.hint412: FSR 4.1.2 Lite in Metal: AMD's 4.1.2 INT8 Lite model, imported from the builder's own AMD DLL. Uses the player's 4.1.2 initializers (tools/fsr4_metal_initializers.sh amdvkffx64.dll).
